# Credits

Everything visual in this project is generated by the code in this repository.
The sound is not: it is recorded material by other people, used under these licences.

| Used for | Work | Author | Licence | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Music (film and game) | "Meditation Impromptu 02" | Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com) | [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) | https://incompetech.com/music/royalty-free/ |
| Birdsong | "Dawnchorus-uk.ogg" — dawn chorus in Shipton Gorge, West Dorset, UK | Silas S. Brown | Public domain | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Dawnchorus-uk.ogg |
| Leaves in the wind | "Rustling leaves" | Gravity Sound | [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Rustling_leaves_(Gravity_Sound).wav |

Changes made: excerpts were trimmed, level-matched, band-limited (to sound as if heard through a closed
window) and mixed. `public/audio/music.m4a` is the level-normalised piece, `public/audio/ambience.m4a`
is a one-minute mix of the two field recordings.
